content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Kanpur Project Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kanpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Postdoctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Postdoctoral Fellow position at IIT Kanpur is 05 October 2026. Candidates are encouraged to apply well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Postdoctoral Fellow position under this recruitment notification (Advt No: P.Rect./R&D/2026/192) at IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Metallurgical Engineering, along with a Bachelor's and Master's degree in the same field, to be eligible for this research-based position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Postdoctoral Fellow position will receive a salary in the range of 60000-5000-85000 as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the IIT Kanpur Project Postdoctoral Fellow recruitment. Candidates can apply for free.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Kanpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly online. Interested candidates must fill out the Google Form provided in the official notification to submit their application.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Postdoctoral Fellow position involves two main stages: shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and a subsequent evaluation process.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a project-based research position at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, specifically focused on CALPHAD-based ICME Design of Steels.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from other states apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all over India who meet the specified educational qualifications are eligible to apply for this position at IIT Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the IIT Kanpur official website or via the link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
